description: This file implements a video decoder for AV1 codec using the dav1d library, handling input buffers, decoding frames, managing decoder state, and providing decoded frames as either textures or video frames.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class that manages AV1 video decoding using the dav1d library, supporting initialization, input buffer processing, frame decoding, and output management.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with specified codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: ~VideoDecoder
methods.description: Destructor that resets the decoder state.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up callback functions for decoder status and error reporting.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals the end of input stream and flushes remaining frames.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, cancels pending jobs, and clears frames.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the current decode target with a new frame.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error message via callback.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Initializes the dav1d decoding context with settings.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Releases the dav1d decoding context and associated resources.

methods.name: DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer, handling data wrapping, sending to dav1d, and outputting frames.

methods.name: DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles flushing remaining frames at end of stream with timeout.

methods.name: TryToOutputFrames
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve and output decoded frames from dav1d.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decoded frame as a decode target for rendering.
